terms.label: tissue
terms.definition: Sample material taken directly from an organism, such as a biopsy, explant or dissected organ, rather than grown in culture.

terms.label: cell culture
terms.definition: Sample material consisting of cells grown in vitro, outside the organism they came from.

terms.label: cell line
terms.definition: A cell culture derived from an established cell population that can be propagated over many passages.

terms.label: organoid
terms.definition: A three-dimensional multicellular structure grown in vitro from stem or progenitor cells that self-organises to reproduce aspects of an organ's architecture and function.
